title: Verify an API key is not stored as plain text
preconditions: The application is running and SQLClient can access the database
steps: 1. Send POST /api/v1/api-keys with a key name. 2. Capture api_key, key_prefix, and id from the 201 response. 3. Query api_keys by the returned id.
expected_result: The returned api_key begins with key_prefix. The database key_prefix matches the response, and hashed_key does not equal the returned plain-text api_key.
